in_marathi.name: Jagjeevan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagjeevan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jagjeevan is derived from Sanskrit, where Jag means God and Jeevan means life. The name signifies the victory of God over the individual's life, implying that God is in control and the individual is living under God's protection and guidance.
